const r=await tools.image_gen__imagegen({transparent_background:true,prompt:"Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production photorealistic 2D ocean-wave animation sprite atlas for side-scrolling space-shooter game. Create a square transparent RGBA image containing exactly FOUR equally sized horizontal strips, stacked in four rows. Each strip is a wide sea wave side elevation viewed from the air a little above its surface, occupying its entire strip width with a common flat baseline at the strip bottom, TRANSPARENT AIR ABOVE. Across the four rows show four consecutive animation phases of the SAME stormy dark teal ocean swell: rising bulge, towering curling crest, crest breaking into white foam, collapsed rolling foam. Continuous realistic dark teal seawater fills the lower part of each strip to its straight baseline. Large believable sculpted water volumes, icy white frothy crest, fine turbulent foam and separated spray droplets; dramatic overcast silver-blue lighting, natural cinematic water detail. All rows have consistent viewpoint, dimensions, water palette and base level so code can blend frames while moving the wave. Wide gradual rolling swell profile with its highest crest toward the right half, taper smoothly to lower water at both edges. The sprite will be composited BELOW the ship, with open air/escape room ABOVE. No sky, horizon, land, boats, people, ship, text, borders, labels or checkerboard. Four clean rows with transparent gutters. True transparency, not black background. Very crisp foam silhouette without neon outline."});store("ocean70_image",r);generatedImage(r);

const r=await tools.image_gen__imagegen({transparent_background:false,prompt:"Use case: photorealistic-natural. Production background plate for a side-scrolling space-shooter game, wide landscape cinematic 16:9 image. View skimming above a turbulent North Atlantic sea during an immense approaching storm. Dark blue-gray overcast clouds dominate upper three quarters, layered luminous silver cloud banks and soft distant rain curtains, subtle shafts of cold daylight, no lightning bolt. Straight distant ocean horizon at 78 percent image height, lower quarter is finely textured dark teal rough sea with white foam streaks flowing horizontally. Open readable airspace in upper and middle image for a small spacecraft to fly. No spacecraft, people, buildings, islands, land, text, overlays or borders. Real photographic water/cloud detail, impressive restrained storm mood, adequate midtone visibility without crushed blacks. Right and left edges have similar tonal values for mirrored seamless tiling. Large foreground breaking waves will be separate transparent sprites; do not include a single close huge wave here."});store("ocean70_backdrop",r);generatedImage(r);

Asset type: photorealistic game environment transition portal sprite atlas, TWO equal square cells SIDE BY SIDE on a wide 2:1 canvas. Left cell: irregular rugged cavern entrance rim made of naturally fractured dark slate rock, a roughly oval open hole in the centre. Each ring fills most of its own square with some exterior transparent padding. BOTH CENTRAL HOLES MUST BE TRULY TRANSPARENT so the next game environment can be seen through them; outside rings also truly transparent. No solid black central disk, no room/interior/background/sky/landscape in holes. No text, grid, captions, divider, characters, ship or neon rails. Restrained cold storm lighting.
